## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// The sum of DegreesOfFreedom squared standard normals.
type ChiSquaredDistribution
    implements IProbabilityDistribution
{
    DegreesOfFreedom: Number;
}

// Student's t distribution; approaches the standard normal as
// DegreesOfFreedom grows.
type StudentTDistribution
    implements IProbabilityDistribution
{
    DegreesOfFreedom: Number;
}

//==
// # Discrete distributions
//
// The distributions supported on the whole numbers: success counts, waiting
// counts, arrival counts, and an explicit weight table over outcome indices.
// Pdf is the probability mass at the value rounded down to a whole number.
// Bodies live in `random.library.plato`.

// A single trial that succeeds with the given probability: mass at 1 for
// success, 0 for failure.
type BernoulliDistribution
    implements IProbabilityDistribution
{
    SuccessProbability: Probability;
}

// The number of successes in TrialCount independent Bernoulli trials.
type BinomialDistribution
    implements IProbabilityDistribution
{
    TrialCount: Integer;
    SuccessProbability: Probability;
}

// The number of failures before the first success in repeated Bernoulli
// trials.
type GeometricDistribution
    implements IProbabilityDistribution
{
    SuccessProbability: Probability;
}

// The count of events in a fixed window when events arrive independently at
// the given mean Rate.
type PoissonDistribution
    implements IProbabilityDistribution
{
    Rate: Number;
}

// A finite distribution over outcome indices 0..count-1: outcome i has
// probability Weights[i] divided by the sum of Weights. Weights are
// non-negative and need not be normalized.
type DiscreteDistribution
    implements IProbabilityDistribution
{
    Weights: Array<Number>;
}

//==
// # Multivariate distributions
//
// Jointly normal distributions over the plane and space
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Multivariate_normal_distribution). These are
// not univariate, so they do not implement IProbabilityDistribution.

// A bivariate normal distribution with the given mean point and covariance.
type NormalDistribution2D
    implements IValue
{
    Mean: Vector2D;
    Covariance: Covariance2D;
}

// A trivariate normal distribution with the given mean point and covariance.
type NormalDistribution3D
    implements IValue
{
    Mean: Vector3D;
    Covariance: Covariance3D;
}
```
